The Grand Entrance and Delivery Boy Sun (Japanese: 登場！！運び屋サン！ He Appears!! Sun the Courier!) is the first chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
 
Two months have passed since the end of the .
arrives in the Alola region to make a delivery. 
Moon meets , a young man working to gain $1 million.
Sun is revealed to own a Pokédex.
Sun attempts to get paid for his services from Team Skull, but ends up having to fight them.
Sun offers to help Moon with her delivery.
